name: Warding Hammerneck
description: Hold the double head up before the chest so either face can meet an incoming blow.

name: Inferno Anvilfall
description: Rap the foe's guard with the first face to start the round of the cycle.

name: Tampvoyage
description: Turn on the lead foot so the next face of the hammer comes round to the foe.

name: Tamp Crown
description: Bring one face down and then the other onto the same spot with qi to crush the plate.

name: Deluge Faceplate
description: Take a cut on one face and swing the second face up to turn it and strike back.

name: Authoritative Hammerface
description: Catch the foe's weapon between the two heads and twist it from his grip.

name: Peenverdict
description: Drop the two faces in turn in two heavy qi-fed falls upon one guard.

name: Sigil Forge
description: Lay both heads across the foe's weapon arm and hold it down with steady qi.

name: Fearless Peenside
description: Drive the first face to stagger the plate and the twin spike through the gap it makes.

name: Resonant Tenet Anvilback
description: School move that strings face and poll blows into one unbroken round that no guard can interrupt.

name: Unwavering Clawside
description: Open the first form with the hammer held wide and high like a wing spread in clear air.

name: Smithverdict
description: Rap the foe in the stillness before the real blow to test the guard and the step.

name: Gliding Cheekplate
description: Move in smooth level paces that keep the head of the hammer at a constant height.

name: Inferno Beakpick
description: Let the head fall from the high guard with qi so it lands like a hawk upon prey.

name: Smithtroth
description: Turn a cut away on the haft in a smooth arc and bring the head back to guard.

name: Entropy Peenbite
description: Hook the beak under a rim and draw the foe's shield aside to open the form's next blow.

name: Majestic Faceplate
description: Crush the crown of the helm with a qi-fed blow that falls in a straight line.

name: Steel Hammerblow
description: Descend upon the foe with the whole weight of the hammer and a gathered field of qi.

name: Gloom Spikeback
description: Press down upon the foe's guard under steady qi until it sags and his stance bends.

name: Drivehome Verdict
description: Drive the spike with the full force of the form so that plate and guard split together.

name: Vigoranvil
description: School move that gathers the ten earlier forms into one descent breaking guard and armor and stance together.

name: Eyehole Pledge
description: Stand low with the feet wide and the hammer held before the hips like a hand cupping water.

name: Noble Peenside
description: Rap the rim of the foe's shield so that the first drop of force enters the course.

name: Peal Hammerneck
description: Scoop the beak under the foe's guard and lift it to leave the body open.

name: Soundless Anvilback
description: Step down the line of the foe's reach in slow even paces as if descending a bank.

name: Haemalanvil
description: Strike the same dent again and again with qi so that it deepens like a basin.

name: Sainted Beakpick
description: Let an enemy blow run over the haft like water over a rim and spill past you.

name: Vigor Forge
description: Tilt the gathered qi into the head in one swing that pours onto the target.

name: Drivehome Vow
description: Hook the beak and turn in a small circle like an eddy so the foe is dragged round.

name: Magma Tamp
description: Slam the hammer low so a flood of qi spreads and staggers every foe around the point.

name: Gloom Hammerblow
description: Lean the head onto a guard and add qi until the foe settles slowly toward the ground.

name: Pulsar Cheekplate
description: Pour the full basin of qi through the spike in one thrust that pierces the thickest plate.

name: Duneforge
description: School move that pours a whole basin of force through the hammer in one wide blow no armor withstands.

name: Clawside Troth
description: Stand with the hammer high like a hawk's wing and the feet planted like the floor of a basin.

name: Bedrock Hammerface
description: Rap the foe's guard in a short high arc and let the hammer rise again at once.

name: Spectral Hammerface
description: Walk in measured paces like a hawk on the ground with the hammer held ready to rise.

name: Eyehole Banner
description: Swing the hammer down in a wide wing-like arc with qi so that it crushes a raised guard.

name: Parity Spikeback
description: Spread the arms and meet a cut with the haft so the force falls into the basin of the stance.

name: Thunderclap Peenbite
description: Hook the beak like a talon over a shield rim and drag it down to open the head.

name: Steelpeen
description: Rise like a hawk and descend with the weight of the settled stance behind the hammer.

name: Gloomsmith
description: Hold the hammer over the foe like a spread wing and press downward with steady qi.

name: Anviltriumph
description: Stoop from height with the spike leading and the weight of the basin so plate shatters.

name: Resonant Season Cheekplate
description: School move that joins a rising feint a falling strike and a settling press in one closing stoop.

name: Stately Beakpick
description: Hold the great head low with both tracks of force settled in the haft before any blow.

name: Smithbanner
description: Rap with the plain weight of the head to learn how the foe takes its force.

name: Smithgrace
description: Pace so that body force and qi step together and neither track falls behind.

name: Heroic Forge
description: Bring the heavy head down with both tracks joined to crush a plate and the arm beneath.

name: Pall Eyehole
description: Turn a blow with the body track and answer at once with the qi track through the haft.

name: Peal Anvilfall
description: Cross the beak over the foe's blade on two tracks of force and wrench it away.

name: Haemal Hammerblow
description: Fall with the great head along both tracks so a guard and the man behind it are broken.

name: Sigil Clawside
description: Pin the foe's weapon beneath the head and hold it with both tracks until his arm gives.

name: Prism Peenbite
description: Join both tracks in the spike so that the blow shatters plate and bone alike.

name: Majestic Spikeback Banner
description: School move that lays the whole weight of both tracks into the head in one blow that ends the exchange.

name: Unyielding Peenside
description: Hold the paired heads before the Core with the haft crossed so each guards the other.

name: Exalted Anvilfall
description: Rap the foe on the beat of the Core's slow pulse to set a rhythm.

name: Bedrock Faceplate
description: Step on the pulse of the Core so the stance never falters between blows.

name: Storied Tamp
description: Draw power from the Core into both heads and crush a guard from front and back.

name: Parity Peenside
description: Hold the haft firm with the Core's strength and turn a heavy blow clean away.

name: Entropy Clawside
description: Hook the beak into the foe's guard and wrench it with power drawn from the Core.

name: Bedrock Beakpick
description: Beat the foe's plate in a pressing rhythm while the Core gives steady power to each blow.

name: Bedrock Anvilback
description: Descend with both heads and the Core's power in one heavy fall upon the foe.

name: Triumphant Tamp
description: Bear down with the haft and let the Core hold the pressure until the foe sinks.

name: Royal Cheekplate
description: Drive the spike with the Core's power and let the second head follow to burst the plate.

name: Prism Faceplate
description: School move that sends the Core's power through both heads in turn and pierces armor and guard.

name: Smithpledge
description: Take the sworn stance with the hammer held low and the wind at the shoulder.

name: Haemal Drivehome
description: Rap the foe's guard with the head and let the wind carry the hammer back round.

name: Unbending Eyehole
description: Hook the beak into a gust and snatch at a shield rim or a strap.

name: Evanescent Drivehome
description: Step with the wind at the heels so the hammer keeps its swing from one round to the next.

name: Steel Hammerneck
description: Drive a gust of qi into the head so the blow lands hard on a helm or shield.

name: Parityanvil
description: Ride a cut away on the wind along the haft and bring the head round.

name: Anvilfall Banner
description: Strike along the sworn bearing with qi so the blow cannot be turned from its mark.

name: Thunderclap Forge
description: Pull with the beak in time with a gust so the foe is dragged forward off balance.

name: Splendid Peenbite
description: Bring the hammer down with a gale of qi in the head so it breaks a raised guard.

name: Season Hammerblow
description: Press the head onto the foe's guard and let wind and qi hold it bowed.

name: Vacuumforge
description: Fall along the sworn bearing with the spike leading and break plate and guard together.

name: Season Spikeback
description: School move that carries the wind through a round of rap and hook and fall to close the cycle.

name: Steadfast Hammerneck
description: Open the first form with the hammer low and the feet set like a rider on the plateau.

name: Steel Anvilback
description: Rap lightly at the foe's guard to pledge the blow that is still to come.

name: Silken Hammerface
description: Step along the edge of the foe's reach in the first pace of the form.

name: Matchless Cheekplate
description: Crush at the point already marked with qi so the oath of the blow is kept.

name: Pall Hammerface
description: Turn a cut along the haft out to the edge while the stance stays whole.

name: Pealsmith
description: Hook the beak into a strap and pull the foe onto the line of the coming blow.

name: Steel Forge
description: Carry the falling hammer to the sworn mark whatever guard the foe raises on the way.

name: Sovereign Hammerblow
description: Hold the head down on the guard and keep the qi pressing until the foe's arms tire.

name: Peentriumph
description: Drive the spike on the sworn line so that plate and guard both break open.

name: Valiant Spikeback
description: School move that keeps the oath of the blow whole from the first guard to a final crushing fall.

name: Steelsmith
description: Take a bearing on the foe with the hammer held low and square to the gale.

name: Haemaltamp
description: Rap along the bearing with the head to fix the foe's guard on that line.

name: Fleet Drivehome
description: Step so that the bearing on the foe stays true as the gale shifts.

name: Squallsmith
description: Crush a guard that stands on the bearing with qi and the weight of the gale.

name: Hammerneck Troth
description: Turn a cut on the haft without losing the bearing set upon the foe's centre.

name: Ruling Peenbite
description: Hook the beak along the bearing and pull a weapon out of the foe's line.

name: Intrepid Anvilback
description: Strike straight along the bearing so that qi and gale meet the foe together.

name: Vigor Peenside
description: Fall along the bearing with the whole heavy head and the push of the gale at the back.

name: Clamping Clawside
description: Press the head onto a foe along the bearing and hold him there with qi and wind.

name: Peencrown
description: Drive the spike along the bearing so plate and body are shattered along the whole line.

name: Heroic Haemal Faceplate
description: School move that sets the gale along the bearing and lets the heavy head carry all of it into the foe.

name: Undefiled Peenside
description: Stand on open ground with the hammer low and no cover on any side.

name: Thunderclap Beakpick
description: Rap the foe's guard on the open ground to draw his weapon away from his body.

name: Squallanvil
description: Step across open ground on a wide arc to take a side the wind favours.

name: Thunderclap Anvilfall
description: Crush a guard with qi in the head and the open wind behind the swing.

name: Deluge Eyehole
description: Turn a cut aside on the haft with a sweep that lets the wind carry the blow away.

name: Venomforge
description: Hook the beak at the edge of a shield and drag it round to open the foe.

name: Triumphant Clawside
description: Bring the heavy head down from the full height of the swing with the wind driving it.

name: Illustrious Eyehole
description: Hold the head on a guard and press with qi until the foe is driven back across the ground.

name: Prism Anvilfall
description: Drive the spike through plate with the whole of the open wind behind the blow.

name: Famed Hammerblow Crown
description: School move that sweeps the hammer round with the full wind so every foe in reach is thrown down.

name: Smithseal
description: Hold the breaking head low and angled so the gale runs round the haft.

name: Inferno Hammerneck
description: Rap the foe's plate with the breaking head to find where it will give.

name: Venomtamp
description: Hook the beak into a gust at the foe's collar and tear his guard aside.

name: Nimble Spikeback
description: Step into the wind with the head low so the gale presses the stance into the ground.

name: Majestic Forge
description: Crush a helm with the breaking head and a pulse of qi from the field.

name: Undefiled Cheekplate
description: Turn a blow aside on the head and haft with the gale running along the wood.

name: Commanding Peenbite
description: Pull a hooked foe forward onto the breaking head so that he meets it unguarded.

name: Squall Hammerface
description: Strike with the field of qi gathered in the head and the push of the gale behind it.

name: Majestic Anvilback
description: Fall upon the foe with the breaking head and all the weight of the field and the gale.

name: Thrallanvil
description: Press the breaking head upon a foe's weapon and hold it with the gale and the field.

name: Pulsartamp
description: Drop the breaking head with the spike leading so that plate and guard shatter in the same instant.

name: Squalltamp
description: School move that joins the field of qi to the gale and sends both through the head at once.

name: Prismsmith
description: Hold the hammer before the Core with the stance sworn to the wind.

name: Faceplate Triumph
description: Rap the foe's guard with a thread of the Core's power on the wind.

name: Anvilvoyage
description: Step on the pulse of the Core so the oath of the stance is never broken.

name: Thunderclap Anvilback
description: Crush a guard with power from the Core held to its sworn mark.

name: Parity Faceplate
description: Turn a heavy cut aside with the haft and let the Core's wind carry it away.

name: Entropy Drivehome
description: Hook the beak into the foe's guard and pull with power drawn from the Core.

name: Tampdecree
description: Bring the hammer down with the Core's wind behind it to crack a raised guard.

name: Anvilbanner
description: Bear down upon the foe with haft and qi until the oath of the blow is kept.

name: Exalted Hammerneck
description: Drive the spike with the Core sworn to the line so that plate and body are shattered.

name: Noble Cheekplate Triumph
description: School move that swears the power of the Core to the wind and sends it through the hammer in one blow.
